target.title: feat(ios): export chat transcripts as Markdown via the share sheet
target.body:
Part of #100415

## What Problem This Solves

Conversations are trapped in the app: there is no way to hand a chat transcript to Mail, Files, Notes, or a colleague.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds a pure, deterministic Markdown formatter to the shared chat package (`ChatTranscriptExporter`): H1 session title, per-message role + ISO8601 UTC timestamp headings, verbatim pass-through for fenced code and tables, `_[attachment: name]_` placeholders, and the same hidden-row filtering the transcript view applies. Filenames are sanitized and UTF-8-length-bounded. The iOS chat screen gains an Export action in the trailing toolbar menu that writes `<session-title>.md` to a temp file and presents the system share sheet. Formatter stays platform-pure (macOS builds untouched); share-sheet wiring is iOS-only.

## User Impact

iOS users can export the current conversation as a named Markdown file to any share-sheet destination. No behavior change otherwise.

## Evidence

- `cd apps/shared/OpenClawKit && swift test --filter ChatTranscriptExporterTests` — 3/3 (snapshot-exact fixture with user/assistant/attachment rows + unicode + code fence; filename sanitization; empty transcript).
- `pnpm ios:build` — BUILD SUCCEEDED (includes SwiftFormat/SwiftLint phases); typography guard updated per apps/ios/AGENTS.md.
- Implementation by Codex (gpt-5.5) from a frozen spec; reviewed line-by-line by the orchestrating session; changelog line removed per release-only policy.
